tabla.purpose: Screen ground and navigation-theme background; the board everything is painted on.

lamina.purpose: Content surface: rows, headers, tab bar. Always bounded by hairline seams, never floating.

tinta.purpose: Headlines, figures, primary button plate, 1.5px interactive outlines.

tintaMedia.purpose: Supporting text, placeholders, Placa labels, inactive tabs, consequence lines.

tintaTenue.purpose: Reserved for text 19px and larger; clears 3:1, not 4.5:1. Currently unused in screens.

regla.purpose: Every seam, divider, surface edge and resting field border.

flash.purpose: Selection and active state only. Three runtime places: Selector fill, quantity plate, active tab plate.

alerta.purpose: Danger and error only. Error Aviso plate, error field, Agotado, rejected-purchase rule.

espera.purpose: Pending and low stock only. Marca tono="espera".

sobreTinta.purpose: Text and icons on a tinta or alerta plate. Never a background.

inerte.purpose: Fill of a disabled control. Disabled is a token pair, never an opacity.

sobreInerte.purpose: Text, icon and border on a disabled control. 6.73:1 on inerte.

mega.purpose: The one figure of the screen. Login wordmark, order total, confirmation number. One per screen, never two. No literal lineHeight.

gigante.purpose: Default Cabecera size and the unit price in every product row. The figure that carries the list. No literal lineHeight.

grande.purpose: Cabecera tamano="grande", the chosen quantity on the yellow plate, the edit-sheet title. No literal lineHeight.

titulo.purpose: Line subtotals, signed-in email, the initial plate, Vacio headings. No literal lineHeight.

cuerpo.purpose: Paragraph text and the text inside Campo.

cuerpoFuerte.purpose: The title line of every FilaRegistro.

menor.purpose: Row support text, Cabecera support line, consequence sentence, Enlace (underlined).

placa.purpose: The signwritten cap label. Placa, button labels (13px/1.1), Marca, Aviso (12px), tab labels (11px/0.9).

motion.name: MS
motion.purpose: The single transition duration in the system. Selector yellow wipe (opacity + scaleX, useNativeDriver). There is no second duration and no easing curve token.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: useMenosMovimiento() reads AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled and subscribes to changes; duration collapses to 0 and the Inventario modal switches animationType to "none". The yellow fill still appears, instantly.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.purpose: Press is the only thing opacity expresses: step buttons 0.6, rows 0.7, buttons 0.75. Android adds a ripple rgba(21,20,15,0.12), or rgba(251,250,246,0.18) on an ink plate. Disabled never uses opacity.

components.name: Boton tinta (primary)
components.description: The one primary action of a screen, docked in the thumb zone. Ink plate, no radius, no shadow.

components.name: Boton contorno (secondary)
components.description: Secondary path. 1.5px ink frame, transparent fill. Disabled becomes an outlined INERT PLATE, never a transparent outline.

components.name: Campo (text field)
components.description: Placa label above, 1px hairline border at rest, 2px ink border on focus with padding compensated so the text never shifts.

components.name: FilaRegistro (the one row grid)
components.description: The only record grid in the app: adorno | (titulo / apoyo / cifra / marca) | derecha, on a sheet, closed by a hairline seam inset 16px.
components.html:
Café molido 500g
Tueste medio · bolsa sellada
$12.500,00
Quedan 3
›

components.name: Selector (signature interaction)
components.description: Radio group inside one 1.5px ink frame. The signwriter yellow wipes in behind the chosen label over 180ms; instant when reduce-motion is on.

components.name: Marca (state chip)
components.description: A boxed cap label. The word is mandatory — this is where "no state by colour alone" is enforced structurally.
components.html: 12 en stock En espera Agotado

components.name: Aviso (transient notice)
components.description: Confirmation is a sheet with a 1.5px ink edge — it deliberately does not use yellow, which belongs to selection. Error takes the solid red plate.
components.html:

narrative.overview:
The world is the hand-painted price board of a market stall, translated to flat ink: primed board, enamel ink, hairline rules, and one signwriter yellow that marks exactly one thing per screen. The direction contract at the top of App.tsx states the thesis in one line — la cifra manda: the price, the stock and the total are the largest ink on every screen. It was written against two predictable alternatives and both were rejected by name: the dark panel with rounded cards and a blue accent that this category always ships, and its obvious opposite, the white board of grey cards with an indigo accent.

Depth in this world comes from the rule, never from elevation. There are no shadows, no elevation, and no corner radius anywhere in the codebase — a grep for shadow, elevation and borderRadius across src/ returns only RADIO, which is 0. Surfaces separate by a StyleSheet.hairlineWidth seam in regla (#D7D5CC) against lamina (#FFFFFF) on the tabla (#F2F1EC) ground. The whole system is almost monochrome, and the direction contract records this as its own honest risk: everything rests on the scale jump between the 11px tracked cap label and the 32–46px black figure. Soften that jump and this is just a grey app.

Density is counter density: short sessions, standing, one hand, variable ambient light. Groups are tight (4–12px), separations are generous (24–44px), every touch target is at least 48dp, and the one primary action of each screen sits docked in the thumb zone at the bottom of the screen.
keyCharacteristics: Flat ink on primed board — zero shadows, zero elevation, zero radius, system-wide.
Hairline seams (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth in regla) are the only separator.
Two typographic extremes only: 11px tracked uppercase placa vs 24–46px Archivo_900Black figures.
One signwriter yellow (flash) reserved to selection; it appears in exactly three runtime places.
One row grid (FilaRegistro) for every record in the app.
One primary action per screen, always docked at the bottom.
No state depends on colour alone; every coloured state carries a word, a weight or a rule.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: flash marks selection or active state and nothing else. It appears in at most one place per screen. If you are reaching for yellow to make something feel important, you want scale, not colour — make the figure bigger.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: No state is communicated by colour alone. Marca always carries the word, the error Campo carries an icon plus a message, the active selector option carries a filled plate and accessibilityState, and the active tab carries a plate behind the icon.

rules.name: The Runnable Contrast Rule
rules.body: src/ui/contraste.check.mjs parses the hex values straight out of tema.ts and asserts every colour-on-colour pair the app actually uses. It currently reports 14 pairs verified, all pass. Run node src/ui/contraste.check.mjs after touching the palette; adding a colour pair to the UI means adding its row to PARES.

rules.name: The Family-Carries-Weight Rule
rules.body: Weight is selected by font family name only (fuente.black, bold, semi, media, regular). Never write fontWeight — with self-hosted named families React Native ignores it and you silently get the wrong face.

rules.name: The No-Literal-LineHeight-On-Figures Rule
rules.body: mega, gigante, grande and titulo carry no lineHeight on purpose: at system font scale a fixed line box clips the figure, while the font metrics scale with it. Only cuerpo (16/23), menor (14/20) and placa (11/16) keep literal line heights.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number read in a column takes CIFRAS_TABULARES (fontVariant tabular-nums). Money is always produced by dinero() from tema.ts, the single place the currency symbol and locale live.

rules.name: The Never-Naked-Figure Rule
rules.body: A quantity never stands alone. The discipline splits by screen on purpose: Productos is forward-looking ("Quedan N si confirmas") because that is where quantity is chosen; Compra carries provenance ("de N que había al agregarlo") because that is where the order is reviewed and the cart holds a snapshot, not live stock. The confirm transaction re-verifies stock before writing.

rules.name: The One Primary Action Rule
rules.body: Exactly one Boton tipo="tinta" per screen, in the footer dock. Secondary paths are Enlace, Boton tipo="contorno", or a bordered inline control.

rules.name: The Isolated Consequence Rule
rules.body: An irreversible action is separated from the content above it by deliberate empty space and preceded by a menor/tintaMedia sentence stating what will happen. The button label then restates the stake.

rules.name: The Seam-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If you need to separate two surfaces, add a Regla or a hairline border. Never add a shadow, never add elevation. A shadow anywhere in this app is a defect.

rules.name: The Opacity-Is-Not-A-State Rule
rules.body: Opacity expresses press only (0.6 / 0.7 / 0.75). Disabled is expressed with the inerte / sobreInerte token pair — measured opacity collapsed the composited text contrast to about 1.6:1.

dos: Do build every new record list from FilaRegistro. It is the one row grid in the app; a new list style is a system violation, not a local choice.
Do separate surfaces with Regla or a StyleSheet.hairlineWidth border in color.regla.

Do put the screen’s one primary action in the footer dock: absolutely positioned at bottom: 0, padding espacio.base, backgroundColor color.tabla, hairline top border, with paddingBottom 96 reserved on the list behind it.
Do make the money, the stock or the total the largest ink on the screen — gigante in a row, mega for the single screen figure — and give it CIFRAS_TABULARES.
Do format every currency value through dinero() from tema.ts. The symbol and locale are a placeholder pending a business decision and must change in exactly one place.
Do pair every coloured state with a word: Marca with its label, an error field with its message, a selected option with its filled plate.
Do state the consequence above an irreversible action and restate the stake in the button label, with deliberate empty space isolating it.
Do run node src/ui/contraste.check.mjs after any palette change, and add a row to PARES for any new colour-on-colour pair you introduce.
Do honour useMenosMovimiento() in anything that animates.
Do keep every touch target at TOQUE_MINIMO (48) or larger.
donts: Don’t add a shadow, an elevation, or a borderRadius. RADIO is 0 and exists so the answer is already written down.
Don’t introduce a new accent colour, and don’t spend flash on anything but selection. It is currently in three runtime places; a fourth needs to replace one of them, not join them.
Don’t use alerta for emphasis or espera for general warnings. Red is danger and error only; ochre is pending and low stock only.
Don’t express disabled with opacity. Use the inerte / sobreInerte pair — opacity measured at roughly 1.6:1 composited contrast.
Don’t write fontWeight. Select the face by family name from fuente.
Don’t add a literal lineHeight to mega, gigante, grande or titulo; the figure must be free to grow with the system font scale.
Don’t define a colour, a size or a spacing value inline in a screen. If it is not in tema.ts, it is not in the system.
Don’t place a critical action in a top corner. The product is used standing, one-handed.
Don’t hard-code a tab bar height or a status bar height; use useSafeAreaInsets() and let React Navigation derive the bar.
Don’t claim live stock on a review surface. Compra shows provenance because the cart holds a snapshot; only the confirm transaction re-reads the database.
